blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The issuer whitepaper documents a pauser that stops transfers, minting and burning and a blacklister that prevents transfers to or from selected accounts. Ethereum transaction 0x6ce282329f6081399248e9cdebb8d00bfbb2c4ea0a0c3d849bb2ff8c10bd1e63 succeeded at block 26128999 (2026-10-05T21:56:23Z): caller 0x27e2cef6a4b4634f96b40eda71357ba3d2eb0142 invoked blacklist(address) on the canonical MXNB proxy 0xf197ffc28c23e0309b5559e7a166f2c6164c80aa and emitted Blacklisted for 0x098b716b8aaf21512996dc57eb0615e2383e2f96. This is an exercised holder-targeted transfer restriction. Materiality: Pharos /api/stablecoins reported aggregate circulating supply of approximately 3,222,945.20 MXNB on 2026-10-19 but no per-chain breakdown across the six deployments, so the Ethereum share cannot be measured from it; the controlled deployment is treated as material fail-closed. The same address is deployed on Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base and Arc, but blacklist controller state on those deployments was not independently verified, so no complete cross-chain roster is claimed.
